name: compare_bundles
description: Compare two canonical Evidence bundles by exact record membership, explicit one-to-one observation pairs, and complete residual-unknown revision histories. Supply absolute local filesystem paths; relative paths are rejected. Missing bundle members describe omission only, never behavioral equivalence; output is digest-anchored and returns every change inline.

left_bundle_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to the left Evidence bundle.

left_evidence_id.description: Exact Evidence identifier for the left observation.

right_evidence_id.description: Exact Evidence identifier for the right observation.

right_bundle_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to the right Evidence bundle.
